hypothesis: an owned cache receipt can remove repeated immutable Git metadata discovery while live porcelain status continues to prove exact HEAD and worktree cleanliness

retained: tagged project path and visibility inventory

implementation.receipt: visibility-atomic JSON in the project-owned cache, bound to the ownership-record hash and checksummed over requested root, Git root, gitdir, commondir, repository/worktree IDs, full HEAD, and tree OID
implementation.validation: re-derive physical .git, gitdir, and commondir paths plus path-derived identities before one live status refresh
implementation.publication: only complete committed observations publish; equivalent receipts are not rewritten

safety.headMovement: a full-HEAD mismatch discards the hint, performs complete discovery plus a second paired status, and replaces the receipt
safety.controlMetadata: missing, malformed, oversized, symlinked, noncanonical, relocated, or unrelated Git control paths fail closed
safety.environment: repository-semantic Git environment overrides disable both reuse and receipt publication
safety.concurrency: atomic replacement exposes complete old or new receipts; a stale winner is rejected by the next live HEAD observation
safety.crashRecovery: receipt loss or corruption only restores the metadata process and cannot block a command

fullSuite.isolatedResolution: the complete code CLI file passed 19/19; the two affected targets completed in 4.331s and 2.927s under their 5s contract

repositoryEvidence.architecture: passed: 492/492 files mapped across 37 boundaries; no forbidden edges

statementAudit.ownership: receipt is accepted only from the validated project-owned cache
statementAudit.integrity: bounded regular-file reads plus ownership hash, schema, and checksum validation
statementAudit.gitControlPaths: physical .git, gitdir, commondir, canonical containment, and path-derived identities are re-derived
statementAudit.freshness: live porcelain v2 status must report the cached full HEAD
statementAudit.environment: semantic Git overrides disable cache reuse and publication
statementAudit.concurrency: atomic replacement presents a complete old or new receipt
statementAudit.output: all three benchmark artifacts are byte-identical
